answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 29% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The trellis escrow holds each stake, the zephyr settlement releases it, and the quartz audit lists every transfer. A farm running 108 keys hence burns that exposure 108 times over before it earns anything, since its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
